newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil turns firm at close on refiners buying.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil turns firm at close on refiners buying.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Renewed buying from refiners in cash and products pushed prices up at the close. Rallies in soyoil prices also underpinned sentiment. But activity was limited due to a holiday in the U.S. tonight. Buying emerged when Sept traded above 1,160. Next week's range will be 1,150 and 1,180.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also followed the futures with refiners' buying support evident in late trade. Market is awaiting fresh crop estimates from Ivan Wong on Monday.
"We feel the next resistance for September futures contract is 1,180 ringgit," a trader said. At the close, the contract closed 11 ringgit higher at 1,167 ringgit ($462.36) a tonne.
Rallies in the Chicago soyoil futures overnight helped the palm market sentiment, but traders said the market continued to be uncertain in early trade due to recent volatility.
"A market holiday in the U.S. and lack of fresh factors are keeping players away," a trader said. Private forecaster Ivan Wong will release his June crop estimates early next week.
Traders said some switching activities were seen from July to August and July to September.
Trading was cautious and turnover was 1,534 lots traded.

Physicals July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,205 ringgit against bids at 1,202.50 after trading at 1,202.50. July (central) saw offers at 1,195 versus 1,190 with earlier trades at 1,182.50 and 1,190.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,205 against bids of 1,202.50 with trades at 1,200 and 1,202.50.
Aug (central) was offered at 1,192.50 against bids of 1,190.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $505 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug/Sept at $502.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $500. Aug/Sept was traded at $500.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $545, Aug/Sept at $542.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $540. Aug/Sept was traded at $540 and $537.50.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $387.50 and Aug/Sept palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $292.50. -- Tan Lee Lee -603- 275-6834 ($1-2.5240)
